title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance
description: An expanded role-playing game set in a ruined Tokyo, combining turn-based battles, demon negotiation and fusion with two story paths: the Canon of Creation and the new Canon of Vengeance.
similar_games: Shin Megami Tensei III Nocturne HD Remaster

player_sentiment.summary: Sampled PC user reviews praise tactical battles, demon fusion and audiovisual style, while some criticize navigation and thin storytelling; these opinions are not a representative survey.
negatives: Tedious map navigation for some players
